Our story

Baked with passion.
Made with intention.

At Chateau Gourmand, dessert is more than the final course. It is the little detail that makes a gathering feel special, a gift feel personal, and an ordinary day feel extraordinary.

From deeply chocolatey brownies to elegant custom cakes, every creation is guided by flavour, texture and a love for the craft. We bring a thoughtful, artisan touch to the moments you want to celebrate.

Before you order

A few helpful details.

Have a question? Here are a few things to know before placing your enquiry.

How do I place an order?

Choose a product or fill in the enquiry form and continue to WhatsApp. Review the prepared message and send it to the bakery. The team will confirm availability and next steps.

Can I request a custom cake?

Yes, use the enquiry form to share your occasion, date, preferred size, flavour and design ideas. The bakery will confirm feasibility and pricing.

Are all listed items available every day?

Not necessarily. Product availability and seasonal collections can change. Please confirm current availability with the bakery before making payment.

How are delivery and payment handled?

Delivery or pickup and payment details are confirmed directly with the bakery. Only use payment details verified by the owner.
